sections.title: Kansas City's Defining AI Markets
sections.description: ClickMasters builds AI specifically for Kansas City's distinctive industry clusters — agriculture, healthcare, financial services, and the Animal Health Corridor.

items.title: Agriculture and Agribusiness (Kansas City's Distinctive AI Market)
items.description: Kansas City is the center of the US agricultural economy — the Kansas City Board of Trade (commodity futures), Cargill's protein operations (Wichita proximity), Tyson Foods (accessibility from KC), Smithfield Foods, and the animal health corridor (Bayer Animal Health, now Elanco, was headquartered in the KC metro area). Crop AI: satellite and drone imagery analysis for crop health monitoring, yield prediction from weather and soil data, and precision agriculture recommendations for KC-area agtech companies and their farmer customers. Animal health AI: disease outbreak prediction, livestock health monitoring from wearable and sensor data, and veterinary clinical analytics. Commodity and supply chain analytics: price prediction models for agricultural commodities traded on Kansas City exchange, basis trading analytics, and supply chain optimization for grain and protein commodity flows.
items.label: Agriculture specialty

items.title: Healthcare
items.description: University of Kansas Health System, Saint Luke's Health System, Children's Mercy Hospital, and the broader KC healthcare community. Epic is the dominant EHR across KC's major health systems. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for KC's hospital networks with Epic FHIR R4 API integration.
items.label: Healthcare

items.title: Financial Services
items.description: H&R Block (KC HQ) creates specific tax AI demand — ML for tax optimization, audit risk prediction, and personalization for H&R Block's massive retail tax customer base. Commercial banking AI for UMB Financial (KC HQ), Commerce Bank, and other KC community and regional banks.
items.label: Financial services

items.title: Animal Health Innovation Corridor
items.description: The 'Animal Health Corridor' extends from Manhattan, KS (Kansas State University) to Columbia, MO — with Kansas City at its center. Elanco (formerly Bayer Animal Health), Phibro Animal Health, Ceva Animal Health, and dozens of animal health startups create a specialized AI market for veterinary diagnostics, animal health monitoring, and livestock management AI.
items.label: Animal health
